summary.name: Cherry Studio
summary.one_liner: Cherry Studio is a free, open-source desktop AI client that gives access to many large language model providers, plus chat, agents, a knowledge base, and local data storage.
use_cases: Comparing answers from several AI models side by side
Chatting with documents and web pages via a knowledge base
Running AI agents that plan and execute multi-step tasks
Using Chinese LLMs such as DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen and GLM in one app
Running local models for offline AI use
summary.what_it_does: Cherry Studio is a cross-platform desktop AI client that connects to 50+ AI service providers (the page also cites 300+ models) including DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, and Zhipu GLM, and supports local model deployment. It offers AI chat, an agent mode where the AI breaks goals into steps and calls tools while the user keeps control, and a knowledge base built from PDF, Word, Excel, TXT, Markdown files and web pages. It also includes side-by-side model comparison, over 300 preset assistants, file and Markdown/Mermaid/code rendering, and support for MCP servers. User data such as chats, settings and knowledge base files is stored locally, with optional WebDAV backup.
notable: Open-source under AGPL-3.0 with a free community edition
Stores conversations, settings and knowledge base files locally
Supports MCP servers and mini-programs for extension
Side-by-side multi-model comparison and 300+ preset assistants
caveats: Commercial use must follow AGPL terms or obtain an enterprise license
Team workspace and enterprise edition are separate offerings; a promotional enterprise trial is mentioned
Page cites both 50+ providers and 300+ models, so the exact count is unclear
